name: Thai Almond Chicken Wraps with Broccoli Slaw
instructions: Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Slice chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season with salt and pepper.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add broccoli slaw and, stirring frequently, cook until tender-crisp, 2-3 minutes. Transfer to a bowl.
Peel and mince garlic and ginger.
Return skillet to stove and add more oil. Add chicken and cook until cooked through, 2-3 minutes per side.
In a small bowl, prepare sauce by whisking together the minced garlic and ginger, almond butter, honey, soy sauce, and water.
Add cashews and sauce to bowl with broccoli and toss to coat.
Wash and dry bell peppers. Seed and slice into thin strips.
Divide broccoli slaw, bell peppers, and chicken among tortillas. Roll up tightly and place seam side down in skillet. Cook until golden brown, 1-2 minutes per side.
To serve, place wraps on a plate. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
